Bob is red. (Fact)  
All red people are quiet. (Rule)  
∴ Bob is quiet. (From Bob is red and the rule)  

Bob is red and Bob is quiet. (From the two facts above)  
All red, quiet people are kind. (Rule)  
∴ Bob is kind. (From Bob is red, Bob is quiet, and the rule)  

The statement “Bob is not kind” contradicts the derived fact that Bob is kind. Therefore the statement does not follow.

ANSWER: False
